faqs.answer: Hello! Welcome to the CMS Events Assistant. Choose an event category or ask me about TECHNOVA 2026.

I cover these categories: TECHNOVA 2026, Cultural Events, Sports Events, Science & Exhibitions, Academic Events and Other CMS Events. TECHNOVA information is the only category with source material currently added. Other categories are available, but their details are marked Coming Soon.

TECHNOVA 2026 is included as a category in this assistant. Ask about a specific competition or share the official brochure so its details can be added accurately. The current project ZIP did not contain the detailed brochure data.
Registration details depend on the event. Confirmed registration links and instructions have not been added for all CMS events. Please check the official school notice.
Rules vary by event. Please refer to the official notice or competition rulebook. Unverified rules are not displayed as facts.
I don't have confirmed dates, timings or venues for every CMS event yet. Please check the latest official school notice.

New events can be added by the project maintainer in data/technova.json under the events list, with a name, category, description and keywords. Then upload the updated file to GitHub so the website redeploys.
For confirmed assistance, please contact your school coordinator or the relevant event organising team.
